title: Task 1: predict which fixture exposes n+1
notes: 2 minutes / practice. Teaching intent: Task 1: predict which fixture exposes n+1. Define: Select a nonzero-mean case before running the buggy candidate. Expected answer and boundary: Report the pass honestly but inspect whether the fixture discriminates the suspected defect. Visual purpose: show Prediction > Chosen fixture > Observed mean > Explain.
